lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Your port thruster is coughing. Your coolant loop is worse. I can fix both, but I would rather stop watching you mistreat them.

lines.speaker: charlie
lines.text: Is that an offer to join the crew or an insult?

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Ten crates of supplies up front. After that I insult the ship professionally.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Deal. Show me the engine room before something there develops opinions.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then I will pretend I never saw your coolant loop.

options.line: I cannot make that deal today.
